name: auraleads-social-worker
description: Poller that runs LinkedIn/Instagram browser-automation jobs, plus email/X sends, queued by the AuraLeads AI app. Two run modes: a long-running process (Railway/Render/a small VPS/laptop — Playwright needs a long-lived process for LinkedIn/Instagram) and `--once` (GitHub Actions, email/X only by default — see .github/workflows/social-worker.yml).
